profile.headline: Actively looking for Sr ABAP Dev roles, SQL-related roles, anything in a bioinformatic fields, or any Python roles to pivot into Performance Engineer roles; preferably all outside of consulting
profile.summary:
I am a professional programmer with a Secret security clearance and 10 years’ experience with databases; from creation (EDM, PDM, E-R models) to implementation and maintenance as well as 8 years SAP Technical experience. My SAP knowledge is focused primarily on Customers and Sales Orders (SD) and ranges from data migration and LSMW experience to ABAP code development, debugging, and maintenance and Business Intelligence with Oracle Data Marts experience.

As a SAP Senior Analyst in EY, I put to work my technical capabilities, business acumen, and ability to assimilate to not only acquire but pass down my knowledge to junior resources in the firm. While delivering quality client services, I also monitor the progress, manage the risks, and ensure key figureheads are kept informed throughout the progress of the development as well as carefully managing the expected outputs in line with the provided inputs.

As a Software Developer Senior Analyst at Accenture, I was tasked with maintaining and creating ABAP code to support multiple projects for the "Oakland Hills" project as well as the "Aravalli" project, both of which included with for federal government agencies. I have designed, implemented, and deployed SAP solutions and am capable of maintaining skills in the SAP application process design and configuration. I have continued to grow my knowledge in SAP application design, development, integration, testing, and deployment and am known and sought out by other in-house projects for my meticulous debugging and documentation skills. Have recently also taken training tied to SAP Fiori and would love to pursue anything usability related as I'm enjoying the deep dive in OData and Fiori development.

As an Associate Professional Programmer Analyst at CSC Puerto Rico, I worked for both UTAS and Pratt and Whitney projects while under the CSC umbrella. I was part of the team that successfully completed the largest UTAS/Goodrich data conversion. I was also part of a team in charge of creating training documentation for FRICE-W technologies as well as the BI Production Support team, where I worked with Business Objects, SAP BusinessObjects BI 4.0, Oracle Data Marts, and related technologies.

Part time professor in the Interamerican University of Puerto Rico where I taught the introductory and advanced Database/SQL related courses; as well as other advanced courses under the Computer Science curriculum, such as Assembly Language, Management, Implementation, and Administration of Databases, Commercial Programming, Relational Database Theory, and more.
